name: Maxau
datum: cm above gauge zero (97.721 m NHN, DHHN2016)
license: PEGELONLINE part: DL-DE->Zero-2.0 (WSV). hyd1d part: no data license stated by the BfG (see research/datasets/europe.md); clear before republishing.
notes: 1960-01-01 to 2026-08-10: BfG hyd1d daily mean W (station MAXAU), file https://hyd1d.bafg.de/downloads/df.gauging_data_latest.RDS (Last-Modified Tue, 11 Aug 2026 04:43:04 GMT).

hyd1d values through 2025 are marked measured (validated by the WSV/BfG); values from 2026 are means of PEGELONLINE raw data, not validated, and marked provisional (df.gauging_data help page). hyd1d has no per-value flag.
Missing days inside the hyd1d span: 0; empty values dropped: 0.

After hyd1d: PEGELONLINE 15-minute raw W (WASSERSTAND ROHDATEN), daily mean over MEZ days (UTC+1), rounded to whole cm as hyd1d does, only days with at least 90 of 96 values; all marked provisional. 35 days from 3 saved pull(s): 23700200_W_20261015T1115Z.json, 23700200_W_20261015T1132Z.json, 23700200_W_20261020T1839Z.json.
Gap left unfilled between the end of hyd1d (2026-08-10) and the first PEGELONLINE day (2026-09-15): 35 days.

Gauge zero from PEGELONLINE station metadata: 97.721 m. ü. NHN (DHHN2016), valid from 2017-07-18. hyd1d levels are relative to the gauge zero in force at the time. This date differs from the 2019-11-01 height-system switch seen at most WSV gauges; the reason was not found. The datum-step scan (hyd1d_stepscan.py) shows no step at that date.
Coordinates and river km from PEGELONLINE station metadata (km 362.327, agency STANDORT MANNHEIM).

measurement_history.fact: Start of readings, early reading method and reading hour: not found. The hyd1d record used here starts 1960-01-01.
Iffezheim barrage, about 28 km upstream, completed; erosion of the riverbed below the last barrage was expected (weak source: old study cited in a search result).

PEGELONLINE lists the current gauge zero (97.721 m NHN) as valid from this date, unlike the 2019-11-01 height-system switch at most gauges; the reason was not found. Our neighbor comparison shows no step at that date.
Neighbor comparison (hyd1d_stepscan.py) found no gauge-zero step of 15 cm or more; the relation to nearby gauges drifts by about 10 to 20 cm over decades, consistent with riverbed change.
hyd1d says its daily values through 2025 are validated; values from 2026 are not officially validated.

public_notes: The level is measured against a fixed mark at the gauge, not the riverbed, so it is not the water depth. Values from 2026 are raw readings that have not been checked yet, and August 11 to September 14, 2026 is missing.
